meta.notes: Training 3, lights, locks and devices: the generator yard. A walled yard in three courts, a locked door, a man minding the generator who knows a code, a camera on a battery, a tripwire, the power house on a keypad with the fuel ledger, and a breaker box that takes the lit court, its lens and the beam at once. Regenerate: bun run tools/levels/export.ts train-lights

steps.line: Go in. Left button on the lamp shoots it out
Tap Space at the lock to pick it, then keep still
E puts it away. A grab needs empty hands
When his back is to you, Space behind him grabs him
Space asks him. Keep asking: he knows the door code
Right button chokes him out. Then keep still
Go back out by the door you picked
1, then Right button on the camera: the OCP jams it
Cross while it is blind. Its battery wakes it: Right button again
Right button on the beam's box, once the OCP is charged
Cross while it is out. Right button again if it comes back
Tap Space at the door to type the code, then keep still
Tap Space at the green trunk, then keep still
The beam is back on. Right button again, then cross
One box feeds it all. Space at the breaker box
N is night vision. Walk out through the dark
The gate is locked. Hold Space, wheel to kick, let go
